source_text: Another review of VMMC rollout data found minimal early resumption of sex post-procedure (median 26–40 days, aligning with healing guidelines) and no sustained uptick in risk compensation, attributing any minor perceptions of invulnerability to counseling failures rather than inherent effects. [113]
